description: This bar chart illustrates the sample count distribution across four essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—for two distinct dataset subsets: “Open” (light blue bars) and “Cons.” (pink bars), as defined in the caption. The vertical axis, labeled “Sample Count,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 120 in increments of 20, with tick marks and labels at each interval. The horizontal axis lists the four essay genres in left-to-right order. Each genre has two adjacent bars: the “Open” bar is light blue and the “Cons.” bar is pink, with exact sample counts labeled atop each bar. For Argumentative, the Open set has 79 samples and the Cons. set has 122. For Narrative, Open has 80 and Cons. has 87. For Descriptive, Open has 68 and Cons. has 100. For Expository, Open has 62 and Cons. has 130. The bars are not sorted by height, and no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding is applied to any specific bar. A legend in the top right corner clarifies that “Open” corresponds to the light blue bars and “Cons.” to the pink bars.
